name: Palette Resort Argya Santi Jimbaran
detail: The room is aesthetic, clean, and has a beautiful private terrace. It is located in a strategic area near Unud Jimbaran and the culinary center. Important notes: Access & Parking: The entrance road (Max Adam) is a bit rocky. Basement parking is limited (only 4-5 cars), so it's highly recommended to bring a motorcycle. Cleanliness: The bathroom was a bit sandy upon entering, perhaps because it hasn’t been used for a while, but other areas are fine. Ideal for those looking for a calm and green atmosphere in Jimbaran! 😉🌿🌳

name: Sunday Hotel Arshika Sunset Road
detail: The room is spacious, suitable for a small family, the pool is directly in front of the room, the room is clean, the swimming pool is clean, it is not noisy, and there is hot water.

name: Palette Signature Hotel
detail: Although it's older than the images, the minimum conditions for staying are met. I was concerned about the lack of facilities and the smell of sewage. However, the room was spacious, there was a pool, it was close to the bus stop, and above all, the smiles of the staff were wonderful.

name: Mamaka Bali
detail: The location is truly fantastic. 12 out of 10 points. You also receive tickets for one free drink per person at the rooftop bar. They don’t even frown if you just order a free drink. There is live music at the entrance restaurant until 10 PM. I thought it might be noisy, but because of the building's design, the rooms are narrow on the beach side and long like a row house, so the sound doesn't reach the rooms, and it was quiet. However, the walls are typically thin like those in Bali, but it's somewhat better than usual. Since it’s located in the center of Kuta, you won’t have any trouble finding food, drinks, or massages. Everything is within a one-minute walk. This hotel is definitely a choice for the next time.

name: Abian Harmony Resort Hotel and Spa
detail: The location is great, but the staff's service is exceptional as well. Starting from reception, everyone is kind and actively helps. Watching the staff help load our luggage into the Grab taxi while greeting us made me think that I would like to come back again. Our room was spacious and comfortable even for three people, making it really nice to relax. I could rest well and was almost reluctant to leave. The only downside was the bathroom lighting. The massages here are also good – I've tried other places too – I went twice during my two-night stay. The breakfast was diverse and delicious. It was a leisurely breakfast by the pool without any crowd.

name: Bali Sun Tropical Hotel & Spa Formerly The Sun hotel & Spa Legian
detail: We stayed with my college son and husband. The staff was always smiling, which was very nice. The room had a double bed and we requested one additional single bed for free through Agoda. Daily towel changes and trash collection in the bathroom, and the bed-making was done neatly, so we had a comfortable stay for six days. There was a pool open from 8 AM to 8 PM, and we swam in the morning with my son. There was a restaurant downstairs for breakfast, but we didn't include it in our stay, yet we liked it so we paid for breakfast one day. The food was ordinary. The bar becomes active at night, but we didn't go there. Instead, we went to a bar at the hotel across which was open longer. The location was good as it was just one street back from the main road, making it easy to access the entertainment district. I would like to stay here again when I visit Bali.

name: EDEN Hotel Kuta Bali
detail: We had a really nice stay here. The room was spacious, comfortable, and very clean. The staff were all polite, friendly, and helpful, which made our stay even more enjoyable. There’s also a nice indoor pool, which was great. The only small downside is that the pool bar closes a bit early, but I completely understand. Overall, it was a great experience and definitely good value for money. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. I’d be happy to stay here again!

name: Luminor Hotel Legian Seminyak - Bali
detail: It is located at the boundary between Seminyak and Legian. We utilized three rooms for three adults, and it was comfortable with a king bed and a small sofa. The breakfast was good, especially considering the low price for one night, as they were making egg dishes live. Occasionally, the unit bathroom had a smell of smoke, as if someone was smoking and it was coming back through the ventilation fan, so I would like them to enforce a no-smoking policy thoroughly. I also think it would be perfect if they provided a well-chilled refrigerator.

name: Althia Capsule Quarters
detail: Staying at Althia Capsule during my solo trip was honestly one of the best decisions I made in Bali. From the moment I arrived, the place felt clean, fresh, and very comfortable. The overall atmosphere is calm and relaxing. The capsule itself is very clean and well-maintained, with power outlets conveniently located near both the bed and the desk. The bathroom is also spotless, and they provide essentials like towels, shampoo, and soap. The staff service is excellent. They are very responsive, friendly, and always ready to help. The WiFi works well too, so it’s reliable if you need to stay connected. One of the biggest highlights is the location. It’s only about 15 minutes walk to Double Six Beach, and there are plenty of restaurants, minimarkets, and ATMs nearby. You don't need to worry The only downside might be that the room isn’t fully soundproof, so you can occasionally hear some noise. However, it’s not a major issue since the overall environment remains peaceful. Considering the price, it’s definitely worth it. This place is highly recommended 👍

name: Kutabex Beachfront Hotel
detail: I definitely recommend this hotel if staying in Kuta Beach.
